_meta.description: Quest dialogue for MQ-18: Distant Shores. Year 2 Spring — opening trade routes.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: Jack, now that we've weathered that first winter... I think it's time we stopped just surviving and started connecting.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: Ferris has been picking up faint radio signals from other settlements. Beacon Towns, they call themselves. But we can't reach them without proper navigation charts.

lines.speaker: npc_ferris
lines.text: There's an old navigation relay at the Shattered Coast. Pre-Sundering tech. If we can recover the charts, I can calibrate our transmitter to reach the nearest Beacon.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Coast is Tide Reaver territory. It won't be easy.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Which is exactly why you're the one going. Take a squad of guard bots. I'll brief you on Reaver patrol routes.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Tide Reavers. They hit from the water — fast boats, diving units that bypass walls entirely. Don't underestimate them.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: The relay station is on the eastern bluffs. Stay off the beach — that's their ground. Approach from the ridge.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: And Jack? If you find any military intel on their numbers... bring it back. We'll need it.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Scanning... This coastline once served a major port city. Cargo infrastructure detected beneath the waterline. The relay station should be northeast of our position.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I'm detecting movement patterns consistent with organized patrol routes. The Tide Reavers are disciplined. Interesting.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Navigation relay located. The data banks are partially corroded but... yes. I can extract the charts. Give me a moment.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Fascinating. These charts map settlements across a 200-kilometer radius. At least seven Beacon signals are active. We are not as alone as we thought.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Seven? That's more than I expected.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The nearest is approximately 40 kilometers northeast. Signal designation: 'Thornwall.' They appear to be transmitting a repeating welcome beacon.

lines.speaker: npc_ferris
lines.text: You got them! Let me see... oh, these are beautiful. Pre-war nav data, still intact. Give me a day to calibrate our transmitter.

lines.speaker: npc_ferris
lines.text: With this, we can reach Thornwall. Maybe even the settlements beyond. Coppervale won't be an island anymore.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: Ferris confirmed it — we've made contact with Thornwall. They're sending a trade envoy within the week.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: This changes everything, Jack. We're not just a town anymore. We're part of something bigger.

lines.speaker: npc_gus
lines.text: New trade partners means new goods! I'll need to clear space in the shop. This is wonderful news.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: It also means new responsibilities. If the Iron Marauders learn about these trade routes, they'll want to control them. Stay sharp.
